gates.unit: node --test tests/battle-alamo.test.mjs and tests/battle-alamo-view.test.mjs, the named test and no other

unit.name: the assault an hour late on the calendar
unit.expect: the Alamo is data the engine holds to its rules, dated on the director's calendar, and its assault is the longest held fight
failed: the Alamo is data the engine holds to its rules, dated on the director's calendar, and its assault is the longest held fight

unit.name: a route cuts through the north quarters
unit.expect: every post and every way in and out is walked over the plan a foot at a time without going through a wall
failed: every post and every way in and out is walked over the plan a foot at a time without going through a wall

unit.name: the garrison set down in the fort, as before 2026-09-25
unit.expect: the garrison walks in from the town through the south gate to posts on the walls, a leg at a time, and nobody is set down
failed: the garrison walks in from the town through the south gate to posts on the walls, a leg at a time, and nobody is set down

unit.name: the north battery never comes closer
unit.expect: the siege is lived: the guns every day and the answer, the north battery and the lines closer, the huts, and the night quiet
failed: the siege is lived: the guns every day and the answer, the north battery and the lines closer, the huts, and the night quiet

unit.name: the siege held for a class with nobody there
unit.expect: the clock lives the siege a quarter-day a tick only for a class with somebody there, holds the assault for everybody, and never runs faster
failed: the clock lives the siege a quarter-day a tick only for a class with somebody there, holds the assault for everybody, and never runs faster

unit.name: a courier walks out
unit.expect: a courier rides out through the gate at a rider's pace, reaches Gonzales before the relief rides, and may go back in with it
failed: a courier rides out through the gate at a rider's pace, reaches Gonzales before the relief rides, and may go back in with it

unit.name: the relief rides to Béxar's plaza, inside the Mexican lines
unit.expect: the relief rides from Gonzales to wait short of the lines, rides in with the company to the gate, and walks to a post: never set down
failed: the relief rides from Gonzales to wait short of the lines, rides in with the company to the gate, and walks to a post: never set down

unit.name: everybody falls when the north wall does
unit.expect: each fighter falls when the storming reaches his post - the north wall first, the rooms last - and a woman is spared when it stops
failed: each fighter falls when the storming reaches his post - the north wall first, the rooms last - and a woman is spared when it stops

unit.name: the family's journal is told at the moment he falls
unit.expect: the student may watch their own man fall; the family's journal and its people learn nothing until the word comes
failed: the student may watch their own man fall; the family's journal and its people learn nothing until the word comes

unit.name: every family is sent the Alamo
unit.expect: only the Host and a family with somebody there are sent the Alamo: nobody else, not a count, not a card, and nothing from the future
failed: only the Host and a family with somebody there are sent the Alamo: nobody else, not a count, not a card, and nothing from the future

unit.name: the storming's card not at the man's side
unit.expect: the cards come through the person: none before the alarm on March 6, the alarm's at the man's side with Watch
failed: the cards come through the person: none before the alarm on March 6, the alarm's at the man's side with Watch

unit.name: an old save's garrison left on the plaza
unit.expect: a class saved in the middle of the assault opens in the middle of it; one saved before posts or battles opens without a new saveVersion
failed: a class saved in the middle of the assault opens in the middle of it; one saved before posts or battles opens without a new saveVersion

unit.name: the garrison bunched in the middle of each wall
unit.expect: the garrison stands along its walls, evenly, each wall facing out over itself, and a family's man takes one place on it
failed: the garrison stands along its walls, evenly, each wall facing out over itself, and a family's man takes one place on it

unit.name: the guns are not drawn
unit.expect: the guns fire each dated shot once, the defenders' canister throws a cone of smoke, and the batteries bombard all day
failed: the guns fire each dated shot once, the defenders' canister throws a cone of smoke, and the batteries bombard all day

unit.name: Travis and Joe are not drawn
unit.expect: Travis is drawn at the north battery, says only his documented words there, and falls among the first; Joe hides, then comes out
failed: Travis is drawn at the north battery, says only his documented words there, and falls among the first; Joe hides, then comes out

unit.name: no ladders
unit.expect: the columns carry ladders, climb the north wall on them, and the assault is fought in the dark until the dawn comes up
failed: the columns carry ladders, climb the north wall on them, and the assault is fought in the dark until the dawn comes up

unit.name: the Come and Take It cloth over Béxar
unit.expect: the red flag of no quarter flies over Béxar as a plain red field, never as the Come and Take It flag
failed: the red flag of no quarter flies over Béxar as a plain red field, never as the Come and Take It flag

unit.name: the reminder that he is inside hides the storming's card
unit.expect: the storming's card goes up over the quiet reminder that somebody is inside, and not over a question
failed: the storming's card goes up over the quiet reminder that somebody is inside, and not over a question

unit.name: a man left on the road is never told or turned home
unit.expect: a relief man still on the road when the company goes in is left behind, told so, and turns home
failed: a relief man still on the road when the company goes in is left behind, told so, and turns home

unit.name: a fallen man goes on firing
unit.expect: a family's man at his post fires until the moment he falls, then goes down and lies still, and never fires again
failed: a family's man at his post fires until the moment he falls, then goes down and lies still, and never fires again
